color.note: One palette in five grounds: signal red, orange and coral for energy, off-navy for every button and selection, royal navy-blue for loyalty points. Studio (warm light) is the default for transactional, form and admin views; Crimson, Chrome and Prism are for public, editorial and event moments; Cinema is the scoped dark treatment behind motion surfaces (hero loops, section intros). Status, points and creator-only colors stay separate from the brand accent. v5 taste pass: Studio neutrals lose their pink cast so the warm ground, navy ink and hairlines read as one family; no pure black anywhere; shadows are navy-tinted. v7: a Glass theme (scenic liquid glass) for signed-in pages: deep blurred colour scene, nearly clear panels, white ink.
